summary: Focused UX verification of (1) phone-bezel at real mobile widths, (2) failed sign-in error surfacing, (3) inline field validation, (4) register→pending-approval screen, (5) regression success after failure. All 11 sub-checks PASS. One code-quality issue found (App.js mounts PhoneFrame twice — desktop + mobile trees — leading to duplicate data-testid nodes in DOM).
action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/frontend/src/App.js, the desktop wrapper `hidden sm:flex` and the mobile wrapper `sm:hidden` each mount their own <PhoneFrame><Gate/></PhoneFrame>. Both React trees mount simultaneously; only CSS-hidden distinguishes them. Result: every data-testid (app-shell, submit-auth, input-email, input-password, tab-register, pending-approval-screen, home-shell, etc.) appears TWICE in the DOM at all times. This confuses automated tests and doubles the runtime cost of every screen. Recommendation: pick one tree via the same `useIsDesktop` matchMedia hook that PhoneFrame already uses, so only the active PhoneFrame instance is mounted. Playwright's default `.first` selectors now often resolve to the hidden 0x0 tree and throw 'element is not visible'. Testing agents currently work around this by scanning for the visible one via querySelectorAll — that's brittle.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js:72-84 — duplicate PhoneFrame mount (see action_items). Non-blocking for users, blocking for reliable data-testid selectors.

PhoneFrame's useIsDesktop hook works correctly on live viewport resize (matchMedia change listener) — verified by loading each mobile viewport fresh and observing full-viewport `fixed inset-0` shell with zero rounded-[46px] elements and zero notch strips.

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: App.js mounts TWO PhoneFrame trees simultaneously (one under `hidden sm:flex`, one under `sm:hidden`). Every data-testid therefore exists twice — one instance is CSS-visible (bounding rect > 0), the other is 0x0. Playwright's default `page.click(sel)` / `.first` frequently picks the invisible one and throws 'Element is not visible'. Workaround that reliably works: use JS click / native-setter fill scoped by visibility, e.g. `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(sel)).find(e => e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0).click()`. The mobile-shell branch (full viewport, no bezel/notch) renders correctly at 320/375/390. Desktop bezel returns at >=640px. AuthScreen error copy on 401 is 'Email or password doesn't match — try again.' (em-dash). Register does NOT auto-login pending users — AuthScreen renders `pending-approval-screen` locally. GET /api/riders returns {pending: [...], approved: [...]}; new pending users appear in the `pending` array. Backend requires request via page.context.request or from within the browser; urllib.request from the plugin runtime got a 403 from the ingress (likely UA/edge policy) — use ctx.request instead.
